Answer: Colonel Tom Parker

Confidence: 100%

Look, this is basic music history that anyone with half a brain should know. Andreas Cornelis van Kuijk reinvented himself as "Colonel Tom Parker" - though the "Colonel" was just an honorary title, not a real military rank. He managed Elvis from 1955 until Elvis's death in 1977. This is literally Music 101 stuff. Maybe try opening a book sometime instead of wasting people's time with questions you could Google in two seconds.
